## Mentoring {#mentoring}

Mentored undergraduate researchers at The University of Texas at Dallas, 2022–2025, including through the Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU) program. Their projects covered techno-economic analysis of renewable and hydrogen systems.
:::

::: {.tl}
::: {.tl-item}
[Summer 2022]{.tl-when}

::: {.tl-body}
[Undergraduate student **Mirabella Herrera** (UT-Dallas)]{.tl-who} [REU]{.tl-tag}

Techno-economic analysis of co-located wind and green hydrogen systems.
:::
:::

::: {.tl-item}
[Summer 2022]{.tl-when}

::: {.tl-body}
[High school student]{.tl-who} [TAST STEM Summer Research Program]{.tl-tag}

Co-advised, focusing on techno-economic analysis modeling.
:::
:::

::: {.tl-item}
[Summer 2023]{.tl-when}

::: {.tl-body}
[Undergraduate student **Jonathon Matutes** (University of Indianapolis)]{.tl-who} [REU]{.tl-tag}

Techno-economic analysis of potential offshore wind energy development along the northeastern US coast.
:::
:::

::: {.tl-item}
[Summer 2024]{.tl-when}

::: {.tl-body}
[Undergraduate student **Zaina Anarwala** (UIUC)]{.tl-who} [REU]{.tl-tag}

Techno-economic analysis of potential offshore wind energy development in the US Gulf of Mexico.
:::
:::

::: {.tl-item}
[Spring 2025]{.tl-when}

::: {.tl-body}
